children: Kit Shing Cheung, through Etoiles Zeneo Investment Ltd, disclosed ownership of 68.08% of Etoiles Capital Group Co., Ltd’s Class A Ordinary Shares. The Schedule 13D was accepted on Aug. 31, 2026 and details prior share issuances, transfers, and cancellations that shaped the position. The large stake gives Cheung significant influence over the company’s direction and governance.

Cheung’s filing outlines prior steps, including two moves to "voluntarily surrender 5,000,000 Class B Ordinary Shares" in May 2025 and July 2026 for cancellation, leaving 10,287,000 Class A shares. While he lists no specific new actions, he states he "may seek to influence management of the Issuer or the Board of Directors" and could revisit his plans over time.

Etoiles Zeneo Investment Ltd is a British Virgin Islands holding company for passive investments. Kit Shing Cheung is a Hong Kong-based executive who serves as Director, CEO, and Chairperson of Etoiles Capital Group Co., Ltd. He focuses on controlling positions in his operating company and related holdings to drive corporate strategy.
